title: Cotype of random polytopes
summary: For $N\geq n$, let $P_{N,n}$ be a random polytope in ${\mathbb R}^n$ with vertices $\pm X_i$, $1\leq i\leq N$, where $X_1,\dots,X_N$ are i.i.d standard Gaussian vectors in ${\mathbb R}^n$. Random polytopes $P_{N,n}$, as well as their duals, are classical objects of interest in high-dimensional convex geometry and local Banach space theory. In this paper, we provide a {\it dimension-independent} bound on the cotype of the corresponding normed space $({\mathbb R}^n,\|\cdot\|_{P_{N,n}})$, generated by $P_{N,n}$.
